questions.stem: Which of the following has the least bone marrow suppression?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vincristine

Vincristine, is an anti-cancer medication used in the treatment of breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, kidney cancer, blood cancer, multiple myeloma, lymphoma, and bone cancer.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 924

questions.stem: Which of the following monoclonal antibody is a humanized antibody directed against VEGF-A?
questions.solutionHtml:
Bevacizumab

bevacizumab is a humanized antibody directed against VEGF-A and was the first FDA-approved molecule that specifically targeted angiogenesis.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 931

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a proteasome inhibitor?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ezetimibe

Ezetimibe, is a medicine used to treat high cholesterol. This medicine helps by reducing "bad" cholesterol (LDL). Lowering cholesterol levels reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke. This medicine should be taken with food.

Ezetimibe

  • intestinal cholesterol absorption inhibitor
  • used in hyperlipidemia in combination with statins


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 689

questions.stem: Which of the following is a radioprotector?
questions.solutionHtml:
Amifostine

Amifostine is a phosphorothioate proposed as a radiation-protective agent. It causes splenic vasodilation and may block autonomic ganglia. Amifostine anhydrous is a Cytoprotective Agent. The mechanism of action of amifostine anhydrous is a Free Radical Scavenging Activity.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 936

questions.stem: Among the following options, the Mechanism of action of Temsirolimus is?
questions.solutionHtml:
mTOR inhibitor

mTOR inhibitors are a class of drugs that inhibit the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR), which is a serine/threonine-specific protein kinase that belongs to the family of phosphatidylinositol-3 kinase (PI3K) related kinases (PIKKs). mTOR regulates cellular metabolism, growth, and proliferation.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 941
